primary-hover.$description: Hover for elements filled with bg/neutral/primary, like a white secondary button.

primary-pressed.$description: Pressed state for elements filled with bg/neutral/primary.

secondary.$description: Cards, panels and sections that sit on bg/neutral/primary.

secondary-hover.$description: Hover for elements filled with bg/neutral/secondary.

secondary-pressed.$description: Pressed state for elements filled with bg/neutral/secondary.

tertiary.$description: Low-emphasis fills: chips, tags, hover backgrounds.

inverse.$description: High-contrast fills like tooltips and toasts.

placeholder.$description: Skeleton loaders and empty image or avatar placeholders.

ghost-hover.$description: Hover for things with no fill at rest: ghost buttons, list rows, menu items. Translucent, so it tints whatever is underneath.

ghost-pressed.$description: Pressed state for ghost buttons, list rows and menu items.

overlay.$description: Dimmed backdrop behind modals and drawers.

subtle.$description: Lightest accent tint for banners, alerts and badge backgrounds.

subtle-hover.$description: Hover for soft accent buttons filled with bg/accent/subtle. Use text/accent/strong on top.

subtle-pressed.$description: Pressed state for soft accent buttons. Use text/accent/strong on top.

muted.$description: A step stronger than subtle — selected rows, hover on subtle accent areas.

solid.$description: Bold accent fill for buttons and filled badges. Pair with text/neutral/on-solid.

subtle.$description: Lightest error tint for banners, alerts and badge backgrounds.

subtle-hover.$description: Hover for soft error buttons filled with bg/error/subtle. Use text/error/strong on top.

subtle-pressed.$description: Pressed state for soft error buttons. Use text/error/strong on top.

muted.$description: A step stronger than subtle — selected rows, hover on subtle error areas.

solid.$description: Bold error fill for buttons and filled badges. Pair with text/neutral/on-solid.

subtle.$description: Lightest success tint for banners, alerts and badge backgrounds.

subtle-hover.$description: Hover for soft success buttons filled with bg/success/subtle. Use text/success/strong on top.

subtle-pressed.$description: Pressed state for soft success buttons. Use text/success/strong on top.

muted.$description: A step stronger than subtle — selected rows, hover on subtle success areas.

solid.$description: Bold success fill for buttons and filled badges. Pair with text/neutral/on-solid.

subtle.$description: Lightest warning tint for banners, alerts and badge backgrounds.

subtle-hover.$description: Hover for soft warning buttons filled with bg/warning/subtle. Use text/warning/strong on top.

subtle-pressed.$description: Pressed state for soft warning buttons. Use text/warning/strong on top.

muted.$description: A step stronger than subtle — selected rows, hover on subtle warning areas.

solid.$description: Bold warning fill for buttons and filled badges. Pair with text/neutral/on-solid.

subtle.$description: Lightest info tint for banners, alerts and badge backgrounds.

subtle-hover.$description: Hover for soft info buttons filled with bg/info/subtle. Use text/info/strong on top.

subtle-pressed.$description: Pressed state for soft info buttons. Use text/info/strong on top.

muted.$description: A step stronger than subtle — selected rows, hover on subtle info areas.

solid.$description: Bold info fill for buttons and filled badges. Pair with text/neutral/on-solid.

tertiary.$description: Lowest-emphasis text that still needs to be read: metadata, hints, captions.

on-solid.$description: Text on any solid intent fill (bg/accent/solid, bg/error/solid…).

primary.$description: Accent text. Readable on surfaces and on accent subtle/muted backgrounds.

strong.$description: Higher-contrast accent text for when primary feels too light.

primary.$description: Error text. Readable on surfaces and on error subtle/muted backgrounds.

strong.$description: Higher-contrast error text for when primary feels too light.

primary.$description: Success text. Readable on surfaces and on success subtle/muted backgrounds.

strong.$description: Higher-contrast success text for when primary feels too light.

primary.$description: Warning text. Readable on surfaces and on warning subtle/muted backgrounds.

strong.$description: Higher-contrast warning text for when primary feels too light.

primary.$description: Info text. Readable on surfaces and on info subtle/muted backgrounds.

strong.$description: Higher-contrast info text for when primary feels too light.

tertiary.$description: Lowest-emphasis icons that still needs to be read: metadata, hints, captions.

on-solid.$description: Icons on any solid intent fill (bg/accent/solid, bg/error/solid…).

primary.$description: Accent icons. Readable on surfaces and on accent subtle/muted backgrounds.

strong.$description: Higher-contrast accent icons for when primary feels too light.

primary.$description: Error icons. Readable on surfaces and on error subtle/muted backgrounds.

strong.$description: Higher-contrast error icons for when primary feels too light.

primary.$description: Success icons. Readable on surfaces and on success subtle/muted backgrounds.

strong.$description: Higher-contrast success icons for when primary feels too light.

primary.$description: Warning icons. Readable on surfaces and on warning subtle/muted backgrounds.

strong.$description: Higher-contrast warning icons for when primary feels too light.

primary.$description: Info icons. Readable on surfaces and on info subtle/muted backgrounds.

strong.$description: Higher-contrast info icons for when primary feels too light.

primary.$description: Strongest neutral border: inputs and controls that must be clearly visible (meets 3:1).

secondary.$description: Stronger border for when tertiary gets lost.

tertiary.$description: The everyday border for cards and containers.

quaternary.$description: Quietest border: dividers inside cards and lists.

disabled.$description: Borders on disabled inputs and controls.

subtle.$description: Soft accent border for banners and alerts.

strong.$description: Clear accent border — e.g. an input in an accent state.

subtle.$description: Soft error border for banners and alerts.

strong.$description: Clear error border — e.g. an input in an error state.

subtle.$description: Soft success border for banners and alerts.

strong.$description: Clear success border — e.g. an input in an success state.

subtle.$description: Soft warning border for banners and alerts.

strong.$description: Clear warning border — e.g. an input in an warning state.

subtle.$description: Soft info border for banners and alerts.

strong.$description: Clear info border — e.g. an input in an info state.

primary.$description: Main shadow color, used by the shadow effect styles.

secondary.$description: Softer ambient shadow layer, used by the shadow effect styles.
